collectr: Direct product links; numeric price API not configured
design: Pullfolio: charcoal zip binder printed with a different pixel sprite in every spot, reshuffled on each visit; the front-page search is the cover label in a stitched pocket the print flows around, with an index-card list and a name strip; clicking a sprite opens an info card about its trading cards, joined to the sprite by a yellow cable from a socket into a plug, (first and newest card, printings per year, languages); logo 4c in the site font; ring binder with multi-select language tabs, a set field and variant button that open a shelf under the toolbar listing only the Pokemon's own sets and variants with counts, a page slider in the Pokemon's colour with its sprite as the thumb, page turns, card pull-out and tilt; the pulled-out card has a cream card file with one TCGplayer price sticker, logo tiles for TCGplayer, eBay sold, PriceCharting, Cardmarket and Collectr, and card details (set, number, release date, illustrator, rarity), lit in the Pokemon's colour
cardDetails: details/<key>.json from search/build_catalog.py: illustrator and series, from TCGdex
cardBacks: assets/backs: English, Japanese (1996-2001 and current) backs from Bulbagarden Archives, shown while scans load
collection: My binder: cards you own kept in this browser (IndexedDB), with JSON/CSV backup; value, paid and gain from TCGplayer prices; owned ticks on pockets; 'Mark cards I own' collect mode, Owned/Missing filters and master-set progress in every Pokemon's binder; a Breakdown by set, language and Pokemon that filters the binder, a daily price record kept in the browser (and in backups) drawn as a Value over time chart with the paid line, and Top movers over 7 or 30 days; Graded only, No price and Not in the catalog chips in My binder, Set my value for unpriced cards, and Find its printing for cards missing from the catalog; sync with a private GitHub repo (r12); the Value over time chart, Top movers (7, 30 or 365 days) and a Price history chart in the card file use each printing's weekly TCGplayer market price since February 2024, and a pulled-out card in My binder wears its own Pokemon's theme (r13)
priceHistory: history/<key>.json from search/build_history.py: one TCGCSV archive day a week since 2024-02-12, TCGplayer market price only (no mid-price fallback since r13.1) per product and subtype, rebuilt by the weekly catalog Action
prices: prices/<key>.json, built daily from one TCGCSV archive by search/build_prices.py (the source sits behind search/price_sources.py). The card file and My binder show TCGplayer's market price, else the cheapest TCGplayer Direct listing; the weekly history stands in when a day's file doesn't load. No price worker
browserCheck: r13.5: checked in Chrome, Firefox and WebKit at phone and desktop size. The card file keeps keyboard focus inside it, an Escape during the fly-out closes it, the footer no longer calls stand-in prices live, dates follow the language switch, the undo strip uses the phone's width, a picture with no stand-in shows the card back without a broken-image icon, and there is no tilt hint with reduced motion
catalog: Our own card list (r14): data/ and details/ from search/build_catalog.py, built weekly from TCGdex (cards-database and its API) and TCGplayer products via TCGCSV. Ids are kept through ids/catalog-ids.json. English and Japanese only; Chinese printings were dropped (no open source). Nothing comes from PokéCottage any more
pictures: English from TCGdex first, then TCGplayer's CDN; Japanese from TCGplayer first, then TCGdex; a picture that fails falls back to the other, then the card back
credits: Footer: card data from TCGdex and TCGCSV, and TCGplayer's notice 'This product uses TCGplayer data but is not endorsed or certified by TCGplayer.' in English and Turkish
